title: Delayed transfers, reversals and UTR references - support procedure
content: Tell the assistant which channel was used, then preserve the date, approximate amount and non-sensitive status. The verified demo adapter can inspect a fictional transfer; an unresolved real transfer needs a reference-based bank review rather than a promised timeline.
